newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Aug palm oil output up 11 pct -Ivan Wong.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Aug palm oil output up 11 pct -Ivan Wong.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil output in August is estimated to have risen by 11 percent to 801,000 tonnes over July, crop forecaster Ivan Wong said on Friday.
Wong had earlier forecast a seven percent increase.
Palm oil stocks at end-August are estimated at 785,000 tonnes while exports in August were at a record high of 675,000 tonnes, Wong said in a report.
The official Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) put stocks at end-July at 754,634 tonnes and July exports at 646,017 tonnes.
"Production was still flat in first-half August but picked up strongly in the second half," Wong said.
He said recent survey showed that good harvests in leading producing areas were likely to continue in September/October.

Wong said crude palm oil stocks at the end of August are estimated to have risen to 435,000 tonnes from 401,628 tonnes a month earlier, while processed palm oil stocks dropped slightly to 350,000 tonnes from 353,006 tonnes at end-July.
Exports in August have comfortably surpassed the previous record monthly exports of 658,200 tonnes posted in January 1994, he said.
